basics.name: Afonso Bispo Certo
basics.label: Ph.D. Student
basics.summary: I'm a PhD student at Técnico and researcher at ISR/LARSyS, working on robot task planning with Large Language Models. I focus on enabling robots to understand and act on natural language commands.

employment.summary: Research on intelligent robotic systems for home environments, focusing on General Purpose Service Robots (GPSR) and natural language command execution.
highlights: Developed a speech pipeline combining Whisper for speech recognition with a rule-based Natural Language Understanding module.
Implemented a semantic mapping module to manage environmental knowledge.
Worked on robot task planning using Large Language Models for flexible instruction interpretation.
Focused Master's thesis on replacing rule-based pipelines with LLM-based planners.

leadership.summary: Led youth groups in outdoor expeditions and community service projects, while mentoring scouts in STEM initiatives including the ESA and Raspberry Pi Foundation 'Mission Zero' program. Spearheaded the digital transition to virtual activities during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Developed open-source hardware/software projects, including 'HSTable' (a DIY interactive smart table) and a mechanical physical Turing Machine. Facilitated technical workshops on programming and electronics, and served on the Marketing & Communications team (2021--2022) managing recruitment campaigns and project promotions.
